help.title: How to connect your watch
help.step1: Generate the code above (valid for 5 minutes, locks after 5 attempts).
help.step2: Health app (data sync): open Zepp on your phone → your watch → Apps → Zitto e Corri → Settings → paste the code → Connect.
help.step3: Open the Mini Program on the watch for the first sync.
help.note: The code works once and is valid for 5 minutes: if it expires, generate a new one.

help.title: How to connect it
help.step1: Create a free account on Intervals.icu.
help.step2: In the Zepp app: Profile → Third-party accounts → Intervals.icu.
help.step3: On Intervals.icu, Settings → Amazfit panel: turn on downloading of wellness data and HRV.
help.step4: Also in Settings, at the bottom (Developer): copy the API key and paste it here.
help.note: After a run, open the Zepp app: the run reaches Intervals.icu within seconds, and from there it arrives here within an hour, or right away when you open Zitto e Corri. The whole future plan appears in the Intervals.icu calendar; the next 7 days reach the watch in the Workout app, among the plan's workouts.
